items.teaser: Health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo have gone on strike, further complicating efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak in the…
items.story:
Health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo have gone on strike, further complicating efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak in the region, as the number of cases has exceeded 2,000, resulting in 754 deaths. The strike, which began recently, involves workers who are responsible for tracking and treating Ebola patients, and it has raised concerns about the potential for the disease to spread further. The affected areas are primarily in the northeastern part of the country, where the outbreak was first reported in August 2018. The World Health Organization and other international health agencies have been working to support the Congo's government in responding to the outbreak.

The current Ebola outbreak in the Congo is the second-largest in history, and it has been particularly challenging to contain due to factors such as violence, mistrust of health workers, and limited access to certain areas. The disease has been reported in several provinces, including North Kivu and Ituri, where there have been incidents of violence and displacement, making it difficult for health workers to reach all affected areas. The Congo has experienced several Ebola outbreaks in the past, but this one has been the most severe, with a higher number of cases and deaths reported. The international community has been providing support, including funding, personnel, and medical supplies, to help contain the outbreak.

According to the latest figures from the World Health Organization, there have been 2,007 confirmed cases of Ebola in the Congo, with 754 deaths reported, and the number of new cases continues to rise. The organization has warned that the outbreak is not yet under control and that more needs to be done to prevent further spread of the disease. Health officials have been working to vaccinate people in affected areas, but the strike by health workers has disrupted these efforts, raising concerns about the potential for the disease to spread further. The Congo's government has been working to address the concerns of the striking health workers, including issues related to pay and safety.

The strike by health workers has had a significant impact on the response to the Ebola outbreak, with many patients being left without adequate care. The situation has been further complicated by reports of violence and intimidation against health workers, which has made it difficult for them to access certain areas. The international community has condemned the violence and called for greater support for health workers, who are risking their lives to contain the outbreak. The strike has also raised concerns about the potential for the disease to spread to other countries in the region, which has prompted neighboring countries to take precautions, including screening travelers and preparing for potential cases.

The Ebola outbreak in the Congo has significant regional and global implications, as it has the potential to spread to other countries and cause widespread harm. The World Health Organization has been working with neighboring countries to prepare for potential cases and to prevent the spread of the disease. The outbreak has also highlighted the need for greater investment in health infrastructure and emergency preparedness, particularly in countries with limited resources. The international community has been providing support, but more needs to be done to address the root causes of the outbreak and to prevent future outbreaks.

As the situation continues to evolve, the World Health Organization and other international health agencies will be closely monitoring the outbreak and working to support the Congo's government in responding to it. The striking health workers have raised concerns about their safety and well-being, which will need to be addressed in order to ensure that they can continue to provide critical care to patients. The international community will also need to continue providing support, including funding and medical supplies, to help contain the outbreak and prevent further spread of the disease. The coming weeks will be critical in determining the trajectory of the outbreak, and all stakeholders will need to work together to prevent further harm and to bring the outbreak under control.

items.headline: New Blood Biomarker May Identify Individuals at Elevated Risk of Alzheimer's Onset Within 5-10 Years.
items.teaser: Researchers have made a significant breakthrough in the development of a blood test that can predict the likelihood of developing Alzheim…
items.story:
Researchers have made a significant breakthrough in the development of a blood test that can predict the likelihood of developing Alzheimer's symptoms in healthy adults within 5 to 10 years. This innovative test has the potential to revolutionize the diagnosis and treatment of the disease, which currently affects millions of people worldwide. According to recent studies, the blood test can identify high-risk individuals, allowing for early intervention and potentially slowing down the progression of the disease. The test's accuracy and reliability have been validated through multiple trials, paving the way for its potential use in clinical settings.

Alzheimer's disease is a complex and debilitating condition that affects memory, cognition, and daily functioning, with no known cure currently available. The disease's progression is slow, often taking years or even decades to develop, making early detection crucial for effective management. Historically, diagnosis has relied on cognitive tests, brain scans, and spinal taps, which can be invasive and often yield inconclusive results. The development of a blood test offers a non-invasive and relatively simple alternative, enabling healthcare professionals to identify individuals at risk and provide timely interventions. This breakthrough has significant implications for the medical community, patients, and their families.

The blood test measures specific biomarkers associated with Alzheimer's disease, including beta-amyloid and tau proteins, which are known to accumulate in the brains of affected individuals. Studies have shown that the test can accurately predict the onset of symptoms in 5 to 10 years, with a high degree of sensitivity and specificity. Experts believe that this test could be a game-changer in the diagnosis and treatment of Alzheimer's, enabling healthcare professionals to initiate preventative measures and slow down disease progression. Official statements from leading research institutions and healthcare organizations have welcomed the development, highlighting its potential to improve patient outcomes and reduce the burden on healthcare systems.

The news of the blood test has been met with a mix of excitement and caution from stakeholders, with some experts urging restraint until the test is fully validated and approved for widespread use. Patient advocacy groups have welcomed the development, citing its potential to improve diagnosis and treatment outcomes. The pharmaceutical industry is also taking notice, with several companies investing in research and development of Alzheimer's therapies that could be used in conjunction with the blood test. As the test moves closer to clinical implementation, regulators and healthcare professionals will need to carefully consider its implications and ensure that it is used responsibly and effectively.

The development of the Alzheimer's blood test is part of a broader trend towards earlier detection and prevention of neurodegenerative diseases. Recent advances in genetic research, imaging technologies, and biomarker discovery have paved the way for innovative diagnostic tools and therapies. The global implications of this breakthrough are significant, with potential applications in healthcare systems worldwide. As the world's population ages, the burden of Alzheimer's disease is expected to increase, making the need for effective diagnosis and treatment more pressing than ever. The development of the blood test is a significant step forward in addressing this challenge.

As researchers continue to refine the blood test and move towards clinical implementation, several key questions remain to be answered. How will the test be integrated into existing healthcare systems, and what will be the criteria for its use? What are the potential costs and benefits of widespread adoption, and how will these be balanced? Experts will be watching closely as the test undergoes further validation and regulatory review, with the potential for a significant impact on the diagnosis and treatment of Alzheimer's disease in the years to come.

items.story:
A growing outbreak of cyclosporiasis, a diarrheal illness caused by the cyclospora parasite, has been reported across the United States, with thousands of cases identified. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has confirmed up to 7,000 cases of cyclosporiasis, with a significant cluster of cases reported in the Midwest. As the outbreak continues to spread, concerns about food safety have increased, with many people wondering what they can do to protect themselves. The parasite is typically spread through contaminated food and water, highlighting the importance of proper food handling and hygiene practices.

The cyclospora parasite has been a recurring problem in the United States, with periodic outbreaks reported over the years. However, the current outbreak is notable for its size and scope, with cases reported in multiple states. The parasite is usually associated with imported produce, particularly fresh fruits and vegetables, and outbreaks often occur during the summer months when these products are more widely available. The CDC and other health agencies have been working to identify the source of the outbreak, but so far, no single source has been confirmed. This lack of information has made it difficult for consumers to know what foods are safe to eat.

According to the CDC, the majority of cases have been reported in the Midwest, with Illinois, Iowa, and Wisconsin among the states with the highest number of cases. The agency has also reported that many of the cases are associated with eating at restaurants, highlighting the importance of proper food handling practices in the food service industry. Health officials have emphasized the need for consumers to take precautions when eating out, such as avoiding undercooked or raw produce and making sure that food is handled and stored properly. The CDC has also provided guidance on how to safely handle and cook food at home to reduce the risk of infection.

The outbreak has had a significant impact on the food industry, with many restaurants and food establishments taking steps to ensure that their products are safe for consumption. Some companies have issued recalls of potentially contaminated products, while others have increased their sanitation and hygiene protocols to reduce the risk of contamination. Consumers have also been affected, with many people changing their eating habits and avoiding certain types of food that may be contaminated. The economic impact of the outbreak is also a concern, with the potential for significant losses to the food industry and related businesses.

The cyclospora outbreak has also raised concerns about the broader food safety system in the United States. The fact that the outbreak has been able to spread so widely and rapidly has highlighted the need for more effective surveillance and tracking of foodborne illnesses. Health officials and regulators have called for increased funding and support for food safety programs, as well as improved communication and coordination between different agencies and industries. The outbreak has also underscored the importance of international cooperation on food safety issues, as the global food supply chain becomes increasingly complex and interconnected.

As the outbreak continues to unfold, health officials and consumers will be watching closely for any new developments or updates on the source of the contamination. The CDC and other agencies will continue to investigate and monitor the situation, providing guidance and recommendations to consumers and the food industry. In the meantime, consumers can take steps to protect themselves by practicing good hygiene, cooking food thoroughly, and avoiding potentially contaminated products. The situation is likely to continue to evolve in the coming weeks and months, with ongoing efforts to contain and prevent further spread of the outbreak.

items.story:
Sotheby's recent auction of a nearly complete Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton has raised concerns among scientists and museum curators that the increasing involvement of private buyers in the fossil market is undermining the pursuit of scientific knowledge. The auction, which took place in New York, saw the T. rex skeleton sell for a record-breaking price, highlighting the growing trend of private collectors outbidding museums for valuable fossils. This development has sparked worries that scientifically significant specimens are being lost to private hands, where they may not be accessible for research or public display. As a result, many in the scientific community are calling for greater regulation of the fossil trade to ensure that important specimens are preserved for the benefit of science and society.

The phenomenon of private buyers outbidding museums for fossils is not new, but it has gained momentum in recent years, driven in part by the growing wealth of private collectors and the increasing popularity of fossil collecting as a hobby. Many museums, which have traditionally been the primary repositories of fossil specimens, are finding it difficult to compete with the deep pockets of private collectors, who are often willing to pay top dollar for rare and valuable fossils. This has led to concerns that many scientifically significant specimens are being lost to private collections, where they may not be properly conserved or made available for research. As a result, scientists and museum curators are warning that the pursuit of scientific knowledge is being compromised by the growing commercialization of the fossil trade.

According to officials at Sotheby's, the T. rex skeleton sold at auction for a record-breaking price, exceeding expectations and highlighting the growing demand for fossils among private collectors. The skeleton, which is estimated to be around 67 million years old, is considered one of the most complete and well-preserved T. rex specimens ever found, making it a highly prized acquisition for any museum or collector. However, many scientists and museum curators have expressed disappointment that the specimen was not acquired by a museum, where it could have been made available for research and public display. Instead, the skeleton will be held in a private collection, where its accessibility for scientific study is uncertain.

The sale of the T. rex skeleton has sparked a lively debate among scientists, museum curators, and private collectors about the ethics of fossil collecting and the impact of commercialization on the pursuit of scientific knowledge. Many scientists and museum curators argue that fossils are an important part of our cultural and scientific heritage, and that they should be preserved and made available for research and public display. Private collectors, on the other hand, argue that they are preserving important specimens and making them available for study, even if they are not always accessible to the general public. As the debate continues, many are calling for greater regulation of the fossil trade to ensure that scientifically significant specimens are preserved for the benefit of science and society.

The growing trend of private buyers outbidding museums for fossils has significant implications for the scientific community and the general public. Many museums, which rely on fossil specimens to educate and inform the public about the natural world, are finding it difficult to acquire new specimens, which can limit their ability to develop new exhibits and educational programs. Furthermore, the loss of scientifically significant specimens to private collections can hinder the pursuit of scientific knowledge, as researchers may not have access to important specimens for study. As a result, many are calling for greater collaboration between museums, scientists, and private collectors to ensure that fossils are preserved and made available for research and public display.

As the debate over the ethics of fossil collecting continues, many are watching to see how the scientific community and governments will respond to the growing trend of private buyers outbidding museums for fossils. Some are calling for greater regulation of the fossil trade, including laws and regulations that would require private collectors to make their specimens available for scientific study and public display. Others are advocating for greater collaboration between museums, scientists, and private collectors to ensure that fossils are preserved and made available for research and public display. As the issue continues to unfold, one thing is clear: the pursuit of scientific knowledge and the preservation of our cultural and scientific heritage are at stake, and it will require a concerted effort from all stakeholders to ensure that fossils are preserved for the benefit of science and society.

Microsoft's Secure Boot feature, designed to protect devices from malicious software, has been compromised for over a decade due to a set of outdated UEFI shims. These shims, which were signed by Microsoft, have been found to be vulnerable to exploitation, allowing attackers to bypass Secure Boot and gain unauthorized access to devices. The discovery of this vulnerability has raised concerns about the security of devices that rely on Secure Boot for protection. According to researchers, the vulnerable shims were created over a decade ago, but their existence and potential for exploitation had gone unnoticed until now.

The Secure Boot feature was introduced by Microsoft as a way to ensure that only authorized software can run on a device, preventing malware and other types of malicious code from executing. However, the use of outdated UEFI shims has created a loophole that can be exploited by attackers to bypass these security measures. This vulnerability has significant implications for the security of devices that rely on Secure Boot, including computers, laptops, and other types of equipment.

India and the United Kingdom are set to implement a new trade deal on July 15, which is expected to have significant implications for shoppers in both countries. The agreement, described as the most ambitious and aspirational of Free Trade Agreements, aims to boost trade between the two nations. As a result, consumers can expect to see changes in the prices and availability of various products, from textiles to liquor. The deal has been in the works for some time, with both countries negotiating the terms of the agreement.

The India-UK trade deal is a significant development in the economic relationship between the two countries, with a long history of trade and cultural exchange. The UK is one of India's largest trading partners, and the new agreement is expected to further strengthen their economic ties. The deal is also seen as an important step for the UK, as it seeks to expand its trade relationships outside of the European Union. With the implementation of the agreement, both countries are expected to benefit from increased trade and investment.

Key details of the agreement include the reduction of tariffs on various products, making them cheaper for consumers. For example, Indian textiles and clothing are expected to become more competitive in the UK market, while British products such as Scotch whisky and Wimbledon towels may become more affordable in India. The agreement also includes provisions for self-certification of origin declarations, which will simplify the process of exporting goods between the two countries. According to official statements, the deal is expected to increase trade between India and the UK by billions of dollars.

The implementation of the trade deal is expected to have a significant impact on stakeholders, including businesses and consumers. Indian exporters are likely to benefit from the reduced tariffs, while UK businesses may see increased competition in the Indian market. Consumers in both countries can expect to see a wider range of products available at competitive prices. The deal is also expected to create new job opportunities and stimulate economic growth in both countries. As the agreement comes into force, businesses and consumers will be watching closely to see how it affects the market.

The India-UK trade deal is part of a broader trend of increasing trade and economic cooperation between countries. The agreement is seen as an important step towards strengthening economic ties between India and the UK, and may serve as a model for future trade agreements. The deal also has implications for regional trade relationships, particularly in the context of the UK's exit from the European Union. As the global economy continues to evolve, the India-UK trade deal is likely to have significant regional and global implications.

As the trade deal comes into force, there are still many questions about how it will be implemented and what its long-term effects will be. The Indian government has notified a self-certification framework for origin declarations, which will be crucial in ensuring the smooth implementation of the agreement. Businesses and consumers will be watching closely to see how the deal affects the market, and any potential challenges or opportunities that arise. With the agreement set to increase trade and investment between India and the UK, it will be important to monitor its progress and assess its impact on the economy and trade relationships in the region.

The announcement has sent shockwaves throughout the gaming community, with many of his colleagues and fans taking to social media to wish him well. Schofield's decision to retire marks the end of an era for a man who has been instrumental in shaping the gaming landscape. His contributions to the industry will undoubtedly be remembered for years to come.

Schofield's career in the gaming industry spans several decades, during which he has worked on numerous high-profile projects, including the popular Dead Space and Call of Duty franchises. His experience and expertise have made him a respected figure in the industry, and his passion for gaming has inspired countless developers and gamers alike. Throughout his career, Schofield has been known for his innovative approach to game design and his commitment to creating immersive gaming experiences. His legacy will continue to be felt in the industry, even after his retirement.

In the emotional video announcing his retirement, Schofield reflected on his time in the industry, highlighting the many accomplishments and milestones he has achieved. He also expressed his appreciation for the opportunities he has had and the people he has worked with over the years. Schofield's statement has been met with an outpouring of support from the gaming community, with many praising his contributions to the industry and wishing him a happy retirement. The video has been widely shared on social media, with many fans and colleagues paying tribute to Schofield's dedication and passion for gaming.

The news of Schofield's retirement has sparked a range of reactions from stakeholders in the gaming industry, with many expressing sadness at his departure. However, there is also a sense of celebration and appreciation for the impact he has had on the industry. Schofield's retirement is seen as a significant loss for the gaming community, but it also presents an opportunity for new talent to emerge and for the industry to continue evolving. The announcement has also sparked a wider conversation about the importance of recognizing and rewarding the contributions of industry veterans like Schofield.

The gaming industry is undergoing a period of significant change and growth, with new technologies and trends emerging all the time. Schofield's retirement comes at a time when the industry is facing new challenges and opportunities, from the rise of cloud gaming to the increasing importance of diversity and inclusion. As the industry continues to evolve, it will be interesting to see how Schofield's legacy is remembered and built upon. His contributions to the industry will undoubtedly continue to inspire and influence future generations of gamers and developers.

As Schofield begins his retirement, the gaming community will be watching with interest to see what the future holds for this industry legend. While he may be stepping away from the industry, his impact will continue to be felt for years to come. The question on everyone's mind is what's next for Schofield, and whether he will remain involved in the industry in some capacity. One thing is certain, however: his legacy will continue to inspire and shape the gaming industry for generations to come.

items.headline: Starlink Unveils V5 Satellite Dish, Delivering Enhanced Efficiency and Reduced System Footprint
items.teaser: SpaceX has unveiled its new Starlink V5 dish, a updated version of its satellite internet terminal that reduces power consumption and wei…
items.story:
SpaceX has unveiled its new Starlink V5 dish, a updated version of its satellite internet terminal that reduces power consumption and weight without increasing speeds. The new dish is part of the company's ongoing efforts to improve its satellite internet service, which has been expanding rapidly around the world. According to reports, the Starlink V5 dish is 35% smaller than its predecessor, making it more compact and easier to install. This new design also enables the dish to be more energy efficient, which could lead to cost savings for users.

The development of the Starlink V5 dish is a significant milestone for SpaceX, which has been working to establish itself as a major player in the satellite internet market. The company's Starlink service was launched in 2020 and has since gained thousands of subscribers worldwide. The service uses a constellation of low-Earth orbit satellites to provide high-speed internet access to remote and underserved areas. The new V5 dish is designed to work with the existing Starlink network, providing users with a more efficient and reliable connection.

The Starlink V5 dish features several key improvements, including a 50% reduction in power consumption, which makes it more suitable for use in areas with limited energy resources. The dish is also designed to be more resistant to extreme weather conditions, including high winds and heavy rain. According to SpaceX, the new dish has been tested to withstand hurricane-grade winds, making it a more reliable option for users in areas prone to severe weather. The company has not announced any plans to increase speeds with the new dish, but the improved efficiency and durability are expected to enhance the overall user experience.

The launch of the Starlink V5 dish has been met with positive reactions from users and industry experts, who see the updated design as a significant improvement over the previous version. The reduced power consumption and increased durability are expected to make the service more attractive to users in remote and underserved areas, where energy resources may be limited. The new dish is also expected to help SpaceX expand its market share in the satellite internet sector, which is becoming increasingly competitive.

The development of the Starlink V5 dish is part of a broader trend towards improved satellite internet technology, which is expected to play a major role in bridging the digital divide in the coming years. Several companies, including Amazon and OneWeb, are also working on satellite internet constellations, which are expected to provide high-speed internet access to millions of people around the world. The improved efficiency and durability of the Starlink V5 dish are expected to give SpaceX a competitive edge in this market, but the company will need to continue innovating to stay ahead of its rivals.

As SpaceX continues to roll out the Starlink V5 dish, the company is expected to face increasing competition from other satellite internet providers. The market is expected to become increasingly crowded in the coming years, with several new constellations scheduled to launch. SpaceX will need to continue improving its technology and expanding its service to stay ahead of its rivals, but the company's commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction is expected to serve it well in the years to come. With the Starlink V5 dish, SpaceX has taken an important step towards establishing itself as a leader in the satellite internet market, and the company's future plans will be closely watched by industry experts and users alike.

items.headline: China's economic expansion decelerates to lowest rate in nearly three years despite strong export gains.
items.teaser: China's economy grew at its weakest pace in three years during the second quarter, as sluggish domestic demand offset a surge in exports,…
items.story:
China's economy grew at its weakest pace in three years during the second quarter, as sluggish domestic demand offset a surge in exports, particularly in the electric vehicle and artificial intelligence sectors. The slowdown highlights the challenges facing the country as it seeks to transition towards higher quality growth and a more robust domestic market. Despite the strong export performance, consumer spending and investment remain subdued, weighed down by uncertainty in the property market. This has significant implications for the country's economic trajectory and its ability to create jobs.

The Chinese economy has been experiencing a gradual slowdown in recent years, as the government seeks to rebalance growth away from reliance on exports and towards domestic consumption. This shift is aimed at creating a more sustainable and equitable economy, but it has also led to a period of adjustment, with domestic demand struggling to pick up the slack. The property market, a key driver of growth in the past, has been a major source of uncertainty, with prices and sales slowing in recent months. As a result, policymakers are facing a delicate balancing act, seeking to support growth while also promoting more sustainable and environmentally friendly development.

According to official data, China's economy grew by 6.2 percent in the second quarter, down from 6.4 percent in the first quarter and the weakest pace since 2019. Exports rose by 10.7 percent, driven by strong demand for electric vehicles and artificial intelligence products, but this was not enough to offset the slowdown in domestic demand. Consumer spending rose by just 5.6 percent, while investment grew by 5.8 percent, both of which were below expectations. Officials have acknowledged the challenges facing the economy, with the government's top economic planner stating that the country needs to promote higher quality growth and a stronger domestic market.

The slowdown in China's economy has significant implications for stakeholders, including businesses, investors, and consumers. Many companies, both domestic and foreign, have been impacted by the slowdown in domestic demand, with some reporting lower sales and profits. Investors are also watching the situation closely, with some expressing concerns about the potential impact on the global economy. Consumers, meanwhile, are feeling the effects of the slowdown, with many cutting back on discretionary spending and delaying major purchases. As a result, there is a growing sense of uncertainty and caution, with many waiting to see how the government will respond to the slowdown.

The slowdown in China's economy also has wider regional and global implications, particularly given the country's role as a major trading partner and economic powerhouse. Many countries, including the United States, the European Union, and Japan, have significant trade relationships with China, and a slowdown in the Chinese economy could have a ripple effect on the global economy. Additionally, the slowdown in China's economy could also have implications for regional stability, particularly in East Asia, where China plays a major role in shaping the economic and security landscape. As a result, policymakers and businesses around the world are watching the situation in China closely, seeking to understand the implications and potential consequences.

As the Chinese government seeks to respond to the slowdown, officials are facing a number of key decisions and challenges. One of the main priorities will be to promote higher quality growth and a stronger domestic market, which will require a range of policy measures, including support for consumer spending and investment. Additionally, the government will need to address the uncertainty in the property market, which is weighing on domestic demand, and promote more sustainable and environmentally friendly development. With the economy facing significant challenges, the coming months will be critical, as policymakers seek to stabilize growth and promote a more sustainable and equitable economy.

Manorama Onlineകോഴിക്കോട്ട് 16 കിലോ തൂക്കം വരുന്ന 3140 കഞ്ചാവ് മിഠായി പിടിച്ചെടുത്ത് എക്‌സൈസ് Mathrubhumiകോഴിക്കോട് കൊളത്തറയില്‍ 16 കിലോ കഞ്ചാവ് മിഠായികള്‍ പിടികൂടി Siraj Dailyകോഴിക്കോട്ട് പിടിച്ചെടുത്തത് പതിനാറ് കിലോ തൂക്കം വരുന്ന കഞ്ചാവ് മിഠായി: ബീഹാർ സ്വദേശി പിടിയിൽ Kerala Kaumudiകോഴിക്കോട്ട് എക്‌സൈസിന്റെ വൻ ലഹരിവേട്ട, 16 കിലോ കഞ്ചാവ് മിഠായി പിടിയിൽ Karma News

items.teaser: Ancient DNA can be a powerful tool for helping us reconstruct the long-dead past. Most surviving genetic material comes from the bones an…
items.story: Ancient DNA can be a powerful tool for helping us reconstruct the long-dead past. Most surviving genetic material comes from the bones and teeth of animals that lived in cold environments, where freezing temperatures help prevent decay. While hotter climates are seen as hostile to preservation, researchers have recently extracted DNA from a tooth found in South Africa that may date to around 50,000 years ago—the oldest yet retrieved from sub-Saharan Africa.

items.story: Driving an electric current through a molecule can create a magnetic field. Yet in practice, such fields are often too weak to be detected experimentally. The findings are published in Nature Communications.

items.story: A team of astronomers has discovered a third planet orbiting the star Beta Pictoris. The new planet, Beta Pictoris d, is 100 times fainter than Beta Pictoris b—the first planet discovered in the same system—and is among the lightest exoplanets ever imaged from the ground. After spotting the planet using the European Southern Observatory's Very Large Telescope (ESO's VLT), the team found it had been hiding in archival observations spanning more than a decade.

items.headline: Are humans really the ultimate super-predator?

items.story: Humans are often described as the planet's ultimate "super-predator," but wild animals do not fear every human the same way. After analyzing three decades of research, scientists found that animals become much more alert and spend less time feeding when people pose a real threat, such as hunters or fishers. In contrast, tourists, researchers, and other non-lethal humans trigger far weaker and less predictable reactions.
